timestampQualification: Root supplied exact native/file/control timestamps; public Git commit timestamps were independently read and have whole-second resolution. Closed files were independently read only by exact safe names. No PRIVATE_BINDING/state content was accessed.
measurementQualification: Separate read-only measurements outside A, not a timed reproduction of R4. State presence/type/ignore and protected-directory ACL metadata only were explicitly authorised. No state/binding contents/hash/copy, browser/operator child, IPC or native call. Native A-probe/IPC and root tool/poll/push durations are NOT_MEASURED.
estimateQualification: Two measured preflights plus two measured directory ACL children plus five committed entry evidence reads; excludes actual A probes, child startup and root orchestration. This sum is not an observed actual phase duration and does not include the multiplied beforePhase source callback below.
callbackQualification: Actual original withSharedRehearsalTurn calls beforePhase after EVERY named ownership assertion, including remote control checks. Coordinator beforePhase reruns complete source(sourceCommit), measured twice outside A with no state access. Six such callbacks through entry contribute roughly8.6s standalone source work in addition to local checks; four occur before submit first checks freshness. No ownership/callback execution may be skipped or cached across calls. Initial unmultiplied estimate was incomplete and is corrected here.
